After payment the full method is returned immediately: six stages (goal, question to ask, exit criterion, common mistake), five evidence checks, a seven-column premise ledger, a seven-part report skeleton, six guardrails and two examples, driven by the caller's own model.

What you receive is the method, not analysis of a specific question. The question parameter is only echoed back for reconciliation and logging. If you expect to submit a question and receive an answer, this pack is not for you.

Best suited when the full method text is unavailable locally, should not sit in context permanently, or must stay consistent across multiple agents and projects. 0.30 CNY per call. One call delivers the full pack, with no second interaction required.
